<a id="主张-claim"></a>
## Claim

With one exact reduced presentation and correct leaf interpretation, the coded whole realizes a finite nested joint plan iff the native whole realizes it.

Canonical source: [JointCorrespondence.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/JointCorrespondence.lean)

<a id="前提与对应-hypotheses-and-correspondence"></a>
## Hypotheses and correspondence

- JointCompact, Exact, Reduced, pointwise leaf correctness and a finite Plan.

Each node retains a common witness; leaf identities and cross-branch sharing are not automatically fixed by code existence.
